name: gui_build_optimize
description: GB-2, the optimization part: the pipeline gui_build_full builds (the same steps), then every way the GUI offers to make it faster, each measured the same way -- the frame's GPU time (get_status gpu_timing, the average over the engine's 120-frame window), barriers, scopes, alias groups and passes (get_frame_plan), the Frame Plan's status line and a picture of its Logical graph with each node's GPU timing. Read only: the numbers are remembered, not required, except where a change has to show. Baseline: the bands under the Graph's nodes (GL-2b: 7 / 3 / 9 / 2 / 3 / 2 barriers), the loop's and the lighting pass's Layers, the Physical plan, Barriers, Decisions and Resources tabs; no alias candidate at all, because Add fullscreen pass gives its image TRANSFER_SRC, which makes it non-aliasable and held to the end of the frame. Draw sort set to state batched in Rendering settings: saved, and the plan does not move (as many barriers, scopes and passes) -- nothing in the GUI says the setting did nothing. Features > shadow_directional > Replace with loop version: the shadow depth pass becomes shadow_cascades/0/depth, the plan keeps its size; the only way back to the folded form is Edit > Undo Render Edit. TRANSFER_SRC unticked on the five images the Graph made: the planner forms alias groups, the lit image is freed after its last reader, the bands say aliased and the picture is the same. Count 3 on the bloom loop: one barrier, one scope and one pass fewer, and the zone says x3 copies. Multisampling 4 restarts the engine and the frame's GPU time goes up: the measurement does see a change when there is one. Regions (RPE11b): a project with a direct rendering config has no preset, so no region to pick. Design only (no GUI): folding several nodes, declared decisions, the equivalence mark. Typed: as gui_build_full, and 3 in Count.
